description: Code and data underlying the publication: Data-driven Semi-supervised Machine Learning with Safety Indicators for Abnormal Driving Behavior Detection provides processed driving data and code for semi-supervised abnormal-driving detection using safety indicators. The provider is Research creators via 4TU.ResearchData. Geographical and temporal coverage: The 2025 deposit supports a named study and derives from the UCF-SST CitySim source dataset. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (deposit metadata). The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: This is processed study material. Source-data and dependency licences may differ from the deposit licence. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
